title: चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bhima angrily tells Yudhishthira that clinging to his promise while their enemies enjoy the kingdom is folly; a kshatriya's duty is to fight. Their thirteen months in the forest equal thirteen years, he argues, and with their allies they could win back the kingdom now.
summary.kn: ಶತ್ರುಗಳು ರಾಜ್ಯ ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆಗೆ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಮೂರ್ಖತನ, ಕ್ಷತ್ರಿಯನ ಧರ್ಮ ಯುದ್ಧ ಎಂದು ಭೀಮನು ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕಾಡಿನ ಹದಿಮೂರು ತಿಂಗಳು ಹದಿಮೂರು ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮ, ಮಿತ್ರರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಈಗಲೇ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಗೆಲ್ಲಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ವಾದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीम क्रोध से युधिष्ठिर से कहते हैं कि शत्रुओं के राज्य भोगते हुए प्रतिज्ञा से चिपके रहना मूर्खता है; क्षत्रिय का धर्म युद्ध है। वे तर्क देते हैं कि वन के तेरह महीने तेरह वर्षों के बराबर हैं, और सहयोगियों के साथ वे अभी राज्य वापस जीत सकते हैं।
summary.te: శత్రువులు రాజ్యం అనుభవిస్తుండగా ప్రతిజ్ఞకు అంటిపెట్టుకోవడం మూర్ఖత్వమని, క్షత్రియుని ధర్మం యుద్ధమని భీముడు కోపంతో యుధిష్ఠిరునితో అంటాడు. అడవిలో పదమూడు నెలలు పదమూడేళ్లతో సమానమని, మిత్రులతో కలిసి ఇప్పుడే రాజ్యం గెలవవచ్చని వాదిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: பகைவர்கள் அரசை அனுபவிக்கும்போது சபதத்தைப் பற்றிக்கொண்டிருப்பது மடமை, க்ஷத்ரியனின் கடமை போர் என்று பீமன் சினத்துடன் யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் சொல்கிறான். காட்டில் கழித்த பதின்மூன்று மாதங்கள் பதின்மூன்று ஆண்டுகளுக்குச் சமம், நண்பர்களுடன் இப்போதே அரசை மீட்கலாம் என்று வாதிடுகிறான்.
summary.ml: ശത്രുക്കൾ രാജ്യം അനുഭവിക്കുമ്പോൾ വാക്കിൽ മുറുകെപ്പിടിക്കുന്നത് മൂഢതയാണെന്ന് ഭീമൻ കോപത്തോടെ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് പറയുന്നു; യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുകയാണ് ക്ഷത്രിയധർമ്മം. കാട്ടിലെ പതിമൂന്നു മാസം പതിമൂന്നു വർഷത്തിന് തുല്യമാണെന്നും, സഖ്യകക്ഷികളുമായി ഇപ്പോൾ രാജ്യം വീണ്ടെടുക്കാമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം വാദിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.34; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
याज्ञसेन्या वचः श्रुत्वा भीमसेनोऽत्यमर्षणः ।
निःश्वसन्नुपसंगम्य क्रुद्धो राजानमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Draupadi's words, Bhimasena, in great fury, sighing, came up to the king and spoke angrily.

verses.text:
राज्यस्य पदवीं धर्म्यां व्रज सत्पुरुषोचिताम् ।
धर्मकामार्थहीनानां किं नो वस्तुं तपोवने ॥

meaning.en: "Take the path of kingship that suits a good man and is lawful. What use is it for us, lacking dharma, desire and wealth, to live in an ascetics' forest?"

verses.text:
नैव धर्मेण तद्राज्यं नार्जवेन न चौजसा ।
अक्षकूटमधिष्ठाय हृतं दुर्योधनेन नः ॥

meaning.en: "That kingdom was taken from us by Duryodhana by resorting to crooked dice, not by dharma, not by honesty, not by strength."

verses.text:
गोमायुनेव सिंहानां दुर्बलेन बलीयसाम् ।
आमिषं विघसाशेन तद्वद्राज्यं हि नो हृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "Our kingdom was snatched like meat from lions by a weak jackal, a scavenger of leavings, from the stronger ones."

verses.text:
धर्मलेशप्रतिच्छन्नः प्रभवं धर्मकामयोः ।
अर्थमुत्सृज्य किं राजन्दुर्गेषु परितप्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "Cloaked in a shred of dharma, you have given up wealth, the source of dharma and desire; why, king, do you torment yourself in these hard places?"

verses.text:
भवतोऽनुविधानेन राज्यं नः पश्यतां हृतम् ।
अहार्यमपि शक्रेण गुप्तं गाण्डीवधन्वना ॥

meaning.en: "By following you, our kingdom was taken while we looked on, though even Indra could not have taken it, being guarded by the wielder of Gandiva."

verses.text:
कुणीनामिव बिल्वानि पङ्गूनामिव धेनवः ।
हृतमैश्वर्यमस्माकं जीवतां भवतः कृते ॥

meaning.en: "Our sovereignty was stolen, as bilva fruits from a cripple, or cows from a lame man, while we lived, because of you."

verses.text:
भवतः प्रियमित्येवं महद्व्यसनमीदृशम् ।
धर्मकामे प्रतीतस्य प्रतिपन्नाः स्म भारत ॥

meaning.en: "Because you wished it, Bharata, we fell into this great misfortune, trusting your devotion to dharma and desire."

verses.text:
कर्शयामः स्वमित्राणि नन्दयामश्च शात्रवान् ।
आत्मानं भवतः शास्त्रे नियम्य भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: "Bound by your scripture, best of the Bharatas, we torment our friends and delight our enemies."

verses.text:
यद्वयं न तदैवैतान्धार्तराष्ट्रान्निहन्महि ।
भवतः शास्त्रमादाय तन्नस्तपति दुष्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: "That we did not then and there kill these sons of Dhritarashtra, having accepted your code, that wrong burns us."

verses.text:
अथैनामन्ववेक्षस्व मृगचर्यामिवात्मनः ।
अवीराचरितां राजन्न बलस्थैर्निषेविताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Now look at this way of life, which is like a deer's, unworthy of heroes and not followed by the strong."

verses.text:
यां न कृष्णो न बीभत्सुर्नाभिमन्युर्न सृञ्जयः ।
न चाहमभिनन्दामि न च माद्रीसुतावुभौ ॥

meaning.en: "Neither Krishna nor Bibhatsu nor Abhimanyu nor the Srinjayas, nor I, nor the two sons of Madri, approve of it."

verses.text:
भवान्धर्मो धर्म इति सततं व्रतकर्शितः ।
कच्चिद्राजन्न निर्वेदादापन्नः क्लीबजीविकाम् ॥

meaning.en: "You, wasted by vows, always saying 'dharma, dharma', have perhaps in disgust fallen into the way of life of a eunuch."

verses.text:
दुर्मनुष्या हि निर्वेदमफलं सर्वघातिनम् ।
अशक्ताः श्रियमाहर्तुमात्मनः कुर्वते प्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: "Poor men, unable to win fortune, take up a fruitless disgust that destroys all, and make it their own pleasure."

verses.text:
स भवान्दृष्टिमाञ्शक्तः पश्यन्नात्मनि पौरुषम् ।
आनृशंस्यपरो राजन्नानर्थमवबुध्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "But you, king, with wisdom and strength, seeing manhood in yourself, devoted to gentleness, do not recognize harm."

verses.text:
अस्मानमी धार्तराष्ट्राः क्षममाणानलं सतः ।
अशक्तानेव मन्यन्ते तद्दुःखं नाहवे वधः ॥

meaning.en: "These sons of Dhritarashtra think that we, being forbearing, though strong, are weak; that is the pain, not death in battle."

verses.text:
तत्र चेद्युध्यमानानामजिह्ममनिवर्तिनाम् ।
सर्वशो हि वधः श्रेयान्प्रेत्य लोकाँल्लभेमहि ॥

meaning.en: "If we fought there, unwavering and not turning back, death in all respects would be better; we would gain the worlds beyond."

verses.text:
अथ वा वयमेवैतान्निहत्य भरतर्षभ ।
आददीमहि गां सर्वां तथापि श्रेय एव नः ॥

meaning.en: "Or if we ourselves killed them, best of Bharatas, and took the whole earth, that too would be good for us."

verses.text:
सर्वथा कार्यमेतन्नः स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठताम् ।
काङ्क्षतां विपुलां कीर्तिं वैरं प्रतिचिकीर्षताम् ॥

meaning.en: "This must be done by us in every way, following our own duty, desiring great fame and wanting to avenge the enmity."

verses.text:
आत्मार्थं युध्यमानानां विदिते कृत्यलक्षणे ।
अन्यैरपहृते राज्ये प्रशंसैव न गर्हणा ॥

meaning.en: "For those who fight for themselves, knowing the signs of what must be done, when the kingdom has been taken by others, there is praise and no blame."

verses.text:
कर्शनार्थो हि यो धर्मो मित्राणामात्मनस्तथा ।
व्यसनं नाम तद्राजन्न स धर्मः कुधर्म तत् ॥

meaning.en: "A dharma that exists to torment friends and oneself is called misfortune, king; it is not dharma but bad dharma."

verses.text:
सर्वथा धर्मनित्यं तु पुरुषं धर्मदुर्बलम् ।
जहतस्तात धर्मार्थौ प्रेतं दुःखसुखे यथा ॥

meaning.en: "In every way, dear brother, a man always devoted to dharma but weak in dharma is abandoned by dharma and wealth, as a corpse is by pain and pleasure."

verses.text:
यस्य धर्मो हि धर्मार्थं क्लेशभाङ्न स पण्डितः ।
न स धर्मस्य वेदार्थं सूर्यस्यान्धः प्रभामिव ॥

meaning.en: "One whose dharma is only for the sake of dharma suffers hardship and is not wise; he does not know the meaning of dharma, as a blind man does not know the sun's light."

verses.text:
यस्य चार्थार्थमेवार्थः स च नार्थस्य कोविदः ।
रक्षते भृतकोऽरण्यं यथा स्यात्तादृगेव सः ॥

meaning.en: "And one whose wealth is only for the sake of wealth does not know wealth; he is like a hired man guarding a forest."

verses.text:
अतिवेलं हि योऽर्थार्थी नेतरावनुतिष्ठति ।
स वध्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्महेव जुगुप्सितः ॥

meaning.en: "A man who beyond measure seeks wealth and does not follow the other two is fit to be killed by all beings, as hateful as a brahmin-killer."

verses.text:
सततं यश्च कामार्थी नेतरावनुतिष्ठति ।
मित्राणि तस्य नश्यन्ति धर्मार्थाभ्यां च हीयते ॥

meaning.en: "One who always seeks pleasure and does not follow the others loses friends and falls away from dharma and wealth."

verses.text:
तस्य धर्मार्थहीनस्य कामान्ते निधनं ध्रुवम् ।
कामतो रममाणस्य मीनस्येवाम्भसः क्षये ॥

meaning.en: "Lacking dharma and wealth, his end comes surely when pleasure runs out, like a fish enjoying itself as the water dries up."

verses.text:
तस्माद्धर्मार्थयोर्नित्यं न प्रमाद्यन्ति पण्डिताः ।
प्रकृतिः सा हि कामस्य पावकस्यारणिर्यथा ॥

meaning.en: "So the wise are never careless of dharma and wealth, for these are the source of desire, as the fire-stick is of fire."

verses.text:
सर्वथा धर्ममूलोऽर्थो धर्मश्चार्थपरिग्रहः ।
इतरेतरयोनी तौ विद्धि मेघोदधी यथा ॥

meaning.en: "In every way wealth has dharma as its root and dharma rests on gaining wealth; know them as sources of each other, like cloud and sea."

verses.text:
द्रव्यार्थस्पर्शसंयोगे या प्रीतिरुपजायते ।
स कामश्चित्तसंकल्पः शरीरं नास्य विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: "The delight that arises from contact of objects, wealth and the senses is desire, a thought of the mind; it has no body."

verses.text:
अर्थार्थी पुरुषो राजन्बृहन्तं धर्ममृच्छति ।
अर्थमृच्छति कामार्थी न कामादन्यमृच्छती ॥

meaning.en: "A man seeking wealth, king, attains great dharma; one seeking pleasure attains wealth; and one attains nothing else from desire."

verses.text:
न हि कामेन कामोऽन्यः साध्यते फलमेव तत् ।
उपयोगात्फलस्येव काष्ठाद्भस्मेव पण्डितः ॥

meaning.en: "Desire is not attained through desire; it is only fruit. The wise man sees it like ash from wood, from the use of the fruit."

verses.text:
इमाञ्शकुनिकान्राजन्हन्ति वैतंसिको यथा ।
एतद्रूपमधर्मस्य भूतेषु च विहिंसताम् ॥

meaning.en: "As a fowler kills these birds, so, king, is the form of adharma among those who harm beings."

verses.text:
कामाल्लोभाच्च धर्मस्य प्रवृत्तिं यो न पश्यति ।
स वध्यः सर्वभूतानां प्रेत्य चेह च दुर्मतिः ॥

meaning.en: "One who does not see that dharma arises from desire and greed is killed by all beings, wicked-minded, here and hereafter."

verses.text:
व्यक्तं ते विदितो राजन्नर्थो द्रव्यपरिग्रहः ।
प्रकृतिं चापि वेत्थास्य विकृतिं चापि भूयसीम् ॥

meaning.en: "Clearly you know wealth, the gathering of goods; you know its nature and its many changes."

verses.text:
तस्य नाशं विनाशं वा जरया मरणेन वा ।
अनर्थमिति मन्यन्ते सोऽयमस्मासु वर्तते ॥

meaning.en: "Its loss or ruin through age or death they call misfortune, and that is what has come upon us."

verses.text:
इन्द्रियाणां च पञ्चानां मनसो हृदयस्य च ।
विषये वर्तमानानां या प्रीतिरुपजायते ।
स काम इति मे बुद्धिः कर्मणां फलमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: "The delight that arises as the five senses, the mind and the heart engage with their objects, that I consider desire, the highest fruit of deeds."

verses.text:
एवमेव पृथग्दृष्ट्वा धर्मार्थौ काममेव च ।
न धर्मपर एव स्यान्न चार्थपरमो नरः ।
न कामपरमो वा स्यात्सर्वान्सेवेत सर्वदा ॥

meaning.en: "So seeing dharma, wealth and desire separately, a man should not be devoted to dharma alone, nor to wealth alone, nor to desire alone, but should follow all always."

verses.text:
धर्मं पूर्वं धनं मध्ये जघन्ये काममाचरेत् ।
अहन्यनुचरेदेवमेष शास्त्रकृतो विधिः ॥

meaning.en: "One should practice dharma in the morning, wealth in the middle, and desire last of the day; so the scripture rule goes."

verses.text:
कामं पूर्वं धनं मध्ये जघन्ये धर्ममाचरेत् ।
वयस्यनुचरेदेवमेष शास्त्रकृतो विधिः ॥

meaning.en: "One should follow desire in youth, wealth in middle age and dharma in old age; so the scripture rule goes."

verses.text:
धर्मं चार्थं च कामं च यथावद्वदतां वर ।
विभज्य काले कालज्ञः सर्वान्सेवेत पण्डितः ॥

meaning.en: "Best of speakers, the wise man who knows the time should divide the time properly and serve dharma, wealth and desire, all."

verses.text:
मोक्षो वा परमं श्रेय एष राजन्सुखार्थिनाम् ।
प्राप्तिर्वा बुद्धिमास्थाय सोपायं कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: "Or liberation is the highest good for those seeking happiness, king; or attainment of kingship, by wisdom and with means, delight of the Kurus."

verses.text:
तद्वाशु क्रियतां राजन्प्राप्तिर्वाप्यधिगम्यताम् ।
जीवितं ह्यातुरस्येव दुःखमन्तरवर्तिनः ॥

meaning.en: "So do this quickly, O king, or attain liberation; life in between is painful like a sick man's."

verses.text:
विदितश्चैव ते धर्मः सततं चरितश्च ते ।
जानते त्वयि शंसन्ति सुहृदः कर्मचोदनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "You know dharma and have always practiced it; your friends urge you toward action, knowing you know."

verses.text:
दानं यज्ञः सतां पूजा वेदधारणमार्जवम् ।
एष धर्मः परो राजन्फलवान्प्रेत्य चेह च ॥

meaning.en: "Giving, sacrifice, honoring the good, bearing the Veda and uprightness: this is the highest dharma, which bears fruit here and hereafter."

verses.text:
एष नार्थविहीनेन शक्यो राजन्निषेवितुम् ।
अखिलाः पुरुषव्याघ्र गुणाः स्युर्यद्यपीतरे ॥

meaning.en: "This cannot be practiced by one without wealth, king, though all other virtues be present."

verses.text:
धर्ममूलं जगद्राजन्नान्यद्धर्माद्विशिष्यते ।
धर्मश्चार्थेन महता शक्यो राजन्निषेवितुम् ॥

meaning.en: "The world has dharma as its root, king; nothing is better than dharma, and dharma can be practiced only with great wealth."

verses.text:
न चार्थो भैक्षचर्येण नापि क्लैब्येन कर्हिचित् ।
वेत्तुं शक्यः सदा राजन्केवलं धर्मबुद्धिना ॥

meaning.en: "Wealth cannot be gained by begging or by weakness, O king, nor just by a dharma-minded attitude alone."

verses.text:
प्रतिषिद्धा हि ते याच्ञा यया सिध्यति वै द्विजः ।
तेजसैवार्थलिप्सायां यतस्व पुरुषर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: "You forbade begging, by which a brahmin succeeds; strive, best of men, to win wealth by fierceness alone."

verses.text:
भैक्षचर्या न विहिता न च विट्शूद्रजीविका ।
क्षत्रियस्य विशेषेण धर्मस्तु बलमौरसम् ॥

meaning.en: "Begging is not prescribed, nor the livelihood of vaishyas and shudras, for a warrior in particular; his dharma is the strength of his own arms."

verses.text:
उदारमेव विद्वांसो धर्मं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ।
उदारं प्रतिपद्यस्व नावरे स्थातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: "The wise say that dharma is noble; take up the noble, and you should not remain in what is lower."

verses.text:
अनुबुध्यस्व राजेन्द्र वेत्थ धर्मान्सनातनान् ।
क्रूरकर्माभिजातोऽसि यस्मादुद्विजते जनः ॥

meaning.en: "Understand, lord of kings; you know the eternal dharmas. You are born to cruel deeds, so that people are afraid."

verses.text:
प्रजापालनसंभूतं फलं तव न गर्हितम् ।
एष ते विहितो राजन्धात्रा धर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: "The fruit from protecting subjects is not blameworthy for you; this is your eternal dharma laid down by the Ordainer, king."

verses.text:
तस्माद्विचलितः पार्थ लोके हास्यं गमिष्यसि ।
स्वधर्माद्धि मनुष्याणां चलनं न प्रशस्यते ॥

meaning.en: "If you stray from it, Partha, you will become a laughingstock; swerving from one's own dharma is not praised in men."

verses.text:
स क्षात्रं हृदयं कृत्वा त्यक्त्वेदं शिथिलं मनः ।
वीर्यमास्थाय कौन्तेय धुरमुद्वह धुर्यवत् ॥

meaning.en: "So make your heart a warrior's, cast off this slack mind, take up valor and bear the burden like a yoke-ox, son of Kunti."

verses.text:
न हि केवलधर्मात्मा पृथिवीं जातु कश्चन ।
पार्थिवो व्यजयद्राजन्न भूतिं न पुनः श्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: "No king has ever conquered the earth by only a dharma-minded nature, nor gained prosperity or fortune."

verses.text:
जिह्वां दत्त्वा बहूनां हि क्षुद्राणां लुब्धचेतसाम् ।
निकृत्या लभते राज्यमाहारमिव शल्यकः ॥

meaning.en: "By giving his tongue to many mean, greedy people, by deceit a man gets a kingdom as a porcupine gets his food."

verses.text:
भ्रातरः पूर्वजाताश्च सुसमृद्धाश्च सर्वशः ।
निकृत्या निर्जिता देवैरसुराः पाण्डवर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: "Elder-born brothers, the gods, though greatly prosperous in every way, were defeated by the asuras through deceit, best of the Pandavas."

verses.text:
एवं बलवतः सर्वमिति बुद्ध्वा महीपते ।
जहि शत्रून्महाबाहो परां निकृतिमास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: "Knowing that all belongs thus to the strong, O lord of the earth, mighty-armed one, kill your enemies, relying on supreme deceit."

verses.text:
न ह्यर्जुनसमः कश्चिद्युधि योद्धा धनुर्धरः ।
भविता वा पुमान्कश्चिन्मत्समो वा गदाधरः ॥

meaning.en: "No bowman in battle is equal to Arjuna, and there will be no mace-bearer equal to me."

verses.text:
सत्त्वेन कुरुते युद्धं राजन्सुबलवानपि ।
न प्रमाणेन नोत्साहात्सत्त्वस्थो भव पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: "Even a very strong man fights with courage, king; not by size or eagerness. Be firm in courage, son of Pandu."

verses.text:
सत्त्वं हि मूलमर्थस्य वितथं यदतोऽन्यथा ।
न तु प्रसक्तं भवति वृक्षच्छायेव हैमनी ॥

meaning.en: "Courage is the root of wealth; otherwise it is vain, and it does not last, like the shade of a tree in winter."

verses.text:
अर्थत्यागो हि कार्यः स्यादर्थं श्रेयांसमिच्छता ।
बीजौपम्येन कौन्तेय मा ते भूदत्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: "One seeking a better wealth must give up some wealth, like a seed; let there be no doubt in you here, son of Kunti."

verses.text:
अर्थेन तु समोऽनर्थो यत्र लभ्येत नोदयः ।
न तत्र विपणः कार्यः खरकण्डूयितं हि तत् ॥

meaning.en: "Where loss equals gain and no increase is had, no trade should be made; it is like scratching a donkey."

verses.text:
एवमेव मनुष्येन्द्र धर्मं त्यक्त्वाल्पकं नरः ।
बृहन्तं धर्ममाप्नोति स बुद्ध इति निश्चितः ॥

meaning.en: "In the same way, lord of men, a man who gives up a small dharma and gains a great one is certainly wise."

verses.text:
अमित्रं मित्रसंपन्नं मित्रैर्भिन्दन्ति पण्डिताः ।
भिन्नैर्मित्रैः परित्यक्तं दुर्बलं कुरुते वशे ॥

meaning.en: "The wise break up an enemy rich in friends by separating his friends; weakened by the severed friends and abandoned, he comes under power."

verses.text:
सत्त्वेन कुरुते युद्धं राजन्सुबलवानपि ।
नोद्यमेन न होत्राभिः सर्वाः स्वीकुरुते प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: "A very strong king wins by courage; not by effort or oblations does he win all his subjects."

verses.text:
सर्वथा संहतैरेव दुर्बलैर्बलवानपि ।
अमित्रः शक्यते हन्तुं मधुहा भ्रमरैरिव ॥

meaning.en: "In every way, even a strong man can be killed by weaker men banded together, as the honey-taker by bees."

verses.text:
यथा राजन्प्रजाः सर्वाः सूर्यः पाति गभस्तिभिः ।
अत्ति चैव तथैव त्वं सवितुः सदृशो भव ॥

meaning.en: "As the sun protects all creatures with his rays and also draws up, so be like the sun."

verses.text:
एतद्ध्यपि तपो राजन्पुराणमिति नः श्रुतम् ।
विधिना पालनं भूमेर्यत्कृतं नः पितामहैः ॥

meaning.en: "We have heard that this is the ancient austerity, which our forefathers performed: to protect the earth by rule."

verses.text:
अपेयात्किल भाः सूर्याल्लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रमसस्तथा ।
इति लोको व्यवसितो दृष्ट्वेमां भवतो व्यथाम् ॥

meaning.en: "The world believes that light may leave the sun and splendor the moon, seeing this distress of yours."

verses.text:
भवतश्च प्रशंसाभिर्निन्दाभिरितरस्य च ।
कथायुक्ताः परिषदः पृथग्राजन्समागताः ॥

meaning.en: "In the assemblies, people come together separately and talk, with praises of you and blame of the other."

verses.text:
इदमभ्यधिकं राजन्ब्राह्मणा गुरवश्च ते ।
समेताः कथयन्तीह मुदिताः सत्यसंधताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Brahmins and your elders gather here and happily speak of this above all, your loyalty to truth."

verses.text:
यन्न मोहान्न कार्पण्यान्न लोभान्न भयादपि ।
अनृतं किंचिदुक्तं ते न कामान्नार्थकारणात् ॥

meaning.en: "They say you have never spoken a falsehood out of delusion, meanness, greed, fear, desire or for gain."

verses.text:
यदेनः कुरुते किंचिद्राजा भूमिमवाप्नुवन् ।
सर्वं तन्नुदते पश्चाद्यज्ञैर्विपुलदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: "Whatever sin a king commits while gaining the earth, he later washes away with sacrifices with large gifts."

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददद्ग्रामान्गाश्च राजन्सहस्रशः ।
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यस्तमोभ्य इव चन्द्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: "By giving villages and cows by the thousands to brahmins, king, he is freed from all sins as the moon from darkness."

verses.text:
पौरजानपदाः सर्वे प्रायशः कुरुनन्दन ।
सवृद्धबालाः सहिताः शंसन्ति त्वां युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: "Almost all townsmen and country people, delight of the Kurus, together with old and young, praise you, Yudhishthira."

verses.text:
श्वदृतौ क्षीरमासक्तं ब्रह्म वा वृषले यथा ।
सत्यं स्तेने बलं नार्यां राज्यं दुर्योधने तथा ॥

meaning.en: "As milk in a dog's skin, or the Veda in a shudra, truth in a thief, strength in a woman, so the kingdom in Duryodhana."

verses.text:
इति निर्वचनं लोके चिरं चरति भारत ।
अपि चैतत्स्त्रियो बालाः स्वाध्यायमिव कुर्वते ॥

meaning.en: "This saying has long circulated in the world, Bharata; even women and children repeat it like a lesson."

verses.text:
स भवान्रथमास्थाय सर्वोपकरणान्वितम् ।
त्वरमाणोऽभिनिर्यातु चिरमर्थोपपादकम् ॥

meaning.en: "So board a chariot furnished with all equipment and set out quickly, an enterprise that brings results, long delayed."

verses.text:
वाचयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठानद्यैव गजसाह्वयम् ।
अस्त्रविद्भिः परिवृतो भ्रातृभिर्दृढधन्विभिः ।
आशीविषसमैर्वीरैर्मरुद्भिरिव वृत्रहा ॥

meaning.en: "Having brahmins pronounce blessings today, go to Hastinapura surrounded by your brothers with firm bows, learned in weapons and like venomous snakes, as Indra the Vritra-slayer with the Maruts."

verses.text:
अमित्रांस्तेजसा मृद्नन्नसुरेभ्य इवारिहा ।
श्रियमादत्स्व कौन्तेय धार्तराष्ट्रान्महाबल ॥

meaning.en: "Crushing your enemies with your fierceness, as the slayer of foes did to the asuras, win back your fortune from the sons of Dhritarashtra, mighty one."

verses.text:
न हि गाण्डीवमुक्तानां शराणां गार्ध्रवाससाम् ।
स्पर्शमाशीविषाभानां मर्त्यः कश्चन संसहेत् ॥

meaning.en: "No mortal could bear the touch of arrows shot from Gandiva, vulture-feathered and like poisonous snakes."

verses.text:
न स वीरो न मातङ्गो न सदश्वोऽस्ति भारत ।
यः सहेत गदावेगं मम क्रुद्धस्य संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: "There is no hero, no elephant, no good horse, Bharata, who could withstand the force of my mace when I am angry in battle."

verses.text:
सृञ्जयैः सह कैकेयैर्वृष्णीनामृषभेण च ।
कथं स्विद्युधि कौन्तेय राज्यं न प्राप्नुयामहे ॥

meaning.en: "With the Srinjayas and the Kaikeyas and the bull of the Vrishnis, how could we not win the kingdom in battle, son of Kunti?"
